BETA Close X Card Factory PLC has announced the purchase of 1,000,000 ordinary shares as part of its share repurchase program, with transactions occurring between June 15 and June 19, 2026. The average price paid per share was approximately 64.5 pence, with the highest price at 68.00 pence and the lowest at 62.90 pence. These repurchased shares will be cancelled, reducing the total number of ordinary shares in issue to 343,414,155, excluding treasury shares. Disclaimer* Card Factory PLC 22 June 2026 22 June 2026 Card Factory plc (the "Company") Transactions in own shares Card Factory plc, the UK's leading specialist retailer of greeting cards, gifts and celebration essentials, announces that it purchased the following number of ordinary shares of 1 pence each in the capital of the Company ('Ordinary Shares') through UBS AG London Branch. The Ordinary Shares purchased will be cancelled. Date of purchase: 15 June 2026 16 June 2026 17 June 2026 18 June 2026 19 June 2026 Number of ordinary shares purchased: 147,530 176,347 76,523 120,017 38,790 Highest price paid per share (pence per share): 68.00 65.90 64.50 64.00 64.00 Lowest price paid per share (pence per share): 65.80 62.90 63.80 62.90 63.00 Volume weighted average price paid per share (pence per share): 66.3851 64.3609 64.1923 63.4530 63.4229 The Company notifies the market that at the date of this announcement the Company's issued ordinary share capital comprises 347,281,795 ordinary shares with a nominal value of 1p each ("Ordinary Shares") with each share carrying one vote. In aggregate, 3,867,640 Ordinary Shares are held in treasury. The number of 343,414,155 ordinary shares may be used by shareholders in the Company as the denominator for the calculations by which they will determine if they are required to notify their interest in, or a change in their interest in, the ordinary share capital of the Company under the FCA's Disclosure Guidance and Transparency Rules.
